data.name: Mujtabaa
data.gender_notes: Mujtabaa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mujtabaa is an Islamic name for boys, derived from the Arabic word 'jabbar', meaning 'great' or 'mighty'. In the Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah chooses certain individuals to carry out His will, and Mujtabaa is one of those names given to such chosen ones. The name Mujtabaa carries the meaning “Chosen One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mujtabaa usually hope their child will grow to embody chosen one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the divine selection and endorsement of the bearer.
data.etymology: Mujtabaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chosen One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujtabaa total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
